text: {"rules":[{"jurisdiction":"San Francisco, CA","level":"city","category":"just_cause_eviction","status":"in_force","title":"San Francisco Rent Ordinance just cause eviction requirement","requirement":"A landlord of a unit covered by the Rent Ordinance must have a \"just cause\" reason that is the dominant motive for the eviction.
